item.title: Jon Ossoff wins reelection in Georgia, easily defeating Republican Mike Collins
item.description: A year ago, the Georgia Senate race was considered one of the cycle's marquee Senate showdowns. In the end, Ossoff easily defeated Collins.

item.title: What Democrats plan to prioritize if they retake the House
item.description: This election will determine control of Congress. Rep. Pete Aguilar, who represents California's 33rd Congressional District, shares how Democratic Party leaders are feeling as results come in.

item.title: Results: States decide on voter ID and redistricting ballot measures
item.description: Several states — including Alaska, Arizona, California and Nevada — are voting on changes to how their elections are run, including voter ID measures. Other states decide on redistricting proposals.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Legendary Photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
item.description: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.

item.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
item.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.

item.title: Supreme Court leans toward LGBTQ exclusion for publicly funded Catholic preschools
item.description: The Supreme Court heard arguments Tuesday about Colorado's universal pre-K program and whether religious schools can bar certain families despite the state's anti-discrimination law.

item.title: A Binance engineer thought he was interviewing for a job. Then the hackers pounced
item.description: North Korean hackers pulled off the biggest cyber heist ever by duping a Binance engineer into thinking he was being recruited for a job, the crypto exchange says.

item.title: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
item.description: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.
